justification: Inspected byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/matcher/CollectionErasureMatcher.java, byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/matcher/ElementMatchers.java, and byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/matcher/CollectionErasureMatcherTest.java. The class is only 62 lines and contains one field, one constructor, one doMatch method, and one toString override; it is a thin adapter that converts each TypeDefinition to its erasure and delegates to a supplied matcher. ElementMatchers.java shows it is just a factory target, and the test covers only the single matching behavior, with no evidence of multiple responsibilities or an oversized API.
